219492.overview:
This is a collection that includes the first 3 games of the franchise with some improvements that allow you to revive them in their best form.​

Among the enhancements, we have the original soundtrack of the Sparking! versions, changes in the visualization so that the game adapts to 16:9 screens and restored content that was left unfinished from the versions released at the time.​

However, the main feature of this collection is that It was prepared with voices in Japanese, to be as faithful as possible to the original material, fully subtitled in Spanish, and in NTSC  format for the enjoyment of the people from America.

​We hope you enjoy this collection and take advantage to have it as a compilation of what we already had with some changes designed to bring them back in good shape.

NOTE: In addition to the modifications mentioned the games do not have altered content (No Mods).

417514.overview:
Dragon Ball Z: Trilogy is a special three-game package released exclusively in Mexico and Latin America. It bundles three of the PlayStation 2 Dragon Ball Z games:

    Dragon Ball Z: Budokai Tenkaichi
    Dragon Ball Z: Budokai Tenkaichi 2
    Super Dragon Ball Z

419167.overview: Daisenryaku 1941: Gyakuten no Taiheiyou (大戦略1941～逆転の太平洋～) is an entry in SystemSoft Alpha's Daisenryaku series. At first, it was released by Sammy, and re-released by Sega as the Sega the Best.

419169.overview: Daisan Teikoku Koubouki is a Strategy game, published by Global A, which was released in Japan in 2004.

419170.overview: Daisan Teikoku Koubouki II is a Strategy game, developed by Global A and published by Marionette, which was released in Japan in 2005.

419175.overview:
Dirge of Cerberus is a third-person shooter starring the sullen, enigmatic Vincent Valentine from Square's Final Fantasy VII role-playing game, which debuted on the original PlayStation in 1997. Taking place three years after the PlayStation hit, Dirge of Cerberus focuses on Valentine's vendetta against an underground assault team known as the Deep Ground Soldiers, who have been terrorizing the recovering city of Midgar from its darkest depths. The title refers to Valentine's weapon, a handgun with carvings of the mythological creature Cerberus on its three barrels -- one for each of the hell beast's heads. Players will use this firearm and more to shoot down armies of robotic troops while trying to rescue Midgar's imprisoned citizens along the way. Each defeated enemy offers a varying amount of experience points, allowing Valentine to increase in level and become more powerful as the game progresses.

The International version is a direct port of the North American and European versions, retaining all the gameplay changes that were made for international release. It also adds cutscenes from the multiplayer of the original Japanese release.

423936.overview: Daredevil: The Man Without Fear (originally known as Daredevil: The Video Game during early development) was a third-person beat ‘em up action game based on the Frank Miller Marvel superhero comic of the same name developed by 5,000 Ft. studios. The game was intended to be published by Encore Inc. and was in development for the Sony PlayStation 2, Microsoft Xbox, and PC. The game was cancelled due to Marvel’s ultimate refusal to approve the game due to the various changes that were made due to Sony’s recommendations that steered far from the original concept the developer had sold to the licensor.

424734.overview:
Alternative setting to Da Capo staging Kotori Shirakawa as the main heroine, with a completely rewritten scenario.

The scene takes place after the graduation ceremony. After being crowned at the school beauty contest, Kotori confesses to Jun'ichi, or rather, she intends to. At that time, something happens to Nemu...

424735.overview: This game is a digital recreation of a Daito Giken produced pachi-slot machine (fruit machine / slot machine). This machine is called 'Shake II'.

424736.overview: Derby Tsuku 3: Derby Ba wo Tsukurou! (ダビつく3 ダービー馬をつくろう!) is a PlayStation 2 and Nintendo GameCube horse racing game released exclusively in Japan.

424739.overview: Da Capo II (commonly abbreviated as D.C. II) is a Japanese adult visual novel developed by Circus which was first released on May 26, 2006 for Windows computers. It is a part of the ongoing Da Capo series of games by Circus, and is the direct sequel to Circus' previous title Da Capo released in 2002. Da Capo II is described by Circus as a "ticklish school romance adventure. A fan disc, Da Capo II: Spring Celebration, was released on April 27, 2007 and features springtime stories set after the endings for each of the six Da Capo II heroines. An all-ages consumer port titled Da Capo II: Plus Situation containing additional scenarios was released for the PlayStation 2 in May 2008. The PlayStation 2 version was later ported to PC, titled Da Capo II: Plus Communication and containing the hentai scenes found in the original release, in December 2008.

424741.overview: Derby Tsuku 4: Derby Uma o Tsukurou! is a Sports game, published by Sega, which was released in Japan in 2004.

424742.overview: This game is a digital recreation of a Daito Giken produced pachi-slot machine (fruit machine / slot machine).

424746.overview: Da Capo Four Seasons (〜ダ・カーポ〜 フォーシーズンズ), abbreviated as D.C.F.S., is a Japanese visual novel developed by CIRCUS as part of its Da Capo franchise. It was published for Kadokawa Shoten for Playstation 2 on December 15, 2005.

424748.overview: This game is a digital recreation of an Daito Giken produced pachi-slot machine (fruit machine / slot machine). This machine is themed after the TV series '24'.

424760.overview: D.C.P.S. is an Adventure game, developed by Circus and published by ESP Software, which was released in Japan in 2003.

424761.overview:
Daito Giken Koushiki Pachi-Slot Simulator - Ossu! Banchou is a conversion of the popular Pachi-Slot arcade machine of the same name.

The Playstation 2 version features a perfect simulation of the machine with different camera angles and levels of zoom and also unlockables galleries (sequences, bgm, sounds, etc). This version sold more than 300000 units in Japan.

424762.overview: This game is a digital recreation of a Daito Giken produced pachi-slot machine (fruit machine / slot machine).

424771.overview: Dancing Stage Max is a video game that was released on November 25, 2005, by Konami to the European PlayStation 2 gaming audience. Dancing Stage Max was modeled after Dance Dance Revolution Extreme 2 in America and Dance Dance Revolution Strike in Japan, containing the new Dance Master Mode and improved EyeToy support. Max featured music by Natasha Bedingfield, Sugababes and Franz Ferdinand as well as new and old Konami Originals. Unlike the previous release, Dancing Stage Fusion, Max was not ported to the arcades.

424786.overview: Dream Audition Super Hit Disc 1 is an Action game, published by Pacific Century Cyber Works, which was released in Japan in 2001.

424787.overview:
Haruka has been working at a general office for several years and has been living by herself in a small apartment for a pretty long time. However one day her job is changed and now she has to work under Ichijou of the Sales Department. Ever since this happened, she’s been encountering strange people.

Dessert Love - Sweet Plus Follows successful appearance on the PC, this boys love simulation makes the trip over to the PS2. You play as an office lady who helps out with the design and development of sweets. You'll get to experience love-based scenarios with seven characters, including your superiors and ex-boyfriend.

424788.overview:
Digital Holmes is classified as a Tactical Talk Strategy game. It's set in modern day London, with your taking control of Hugh Ibuka Holmes, descendant of the great Sherlock Holmes. Watson is also in the game, in case you were wondering with the name of Aleph H. Watson.

The game starts at night of the 31-May-2000 in New Scotland Yard when Aleph H. Watson & Thomas Simpson go out and they find a suspicious woman in a roof (Emilia Cartwright) and when they arrive there they find a kid that suddenly run away from them, when they follow him they find the corpse of Jack Holmes, and they discover that the kid is Jack's nephew, Hugh Ibuka Holmes and they will have to work together to solve the case.

The player has 48 hours to solve a particular case, and you do so in classic Japanese adventure game form. The game is set up as an adventure, so you can move freely around the town as you would in an RPG.

424789.overview: The heroine Yuri is unhappy that she’s not as good looking as her twin brother Kairi. When they find a wishing stone, Yuri picks it up and wishes to change her looks, but the stone drops down and breaks. Later one morning when the school year is already started they find that stone back on top of Yuri's bed. When Yuri touches the stone, she and her brother end up switching bodies. While her brother isn’t too happy about being a girl, Yuri can’t wait to spend her time being a boy for once. The body switching seems to be on and off and so the twins’ adventures begin!

424790.overview: On her sixteenth birthday, she meets a mysterious man called Gleude and he tells her that she is a princess candidate and has a special power. However, she needs to improve her power to become princess. She makes up her mind to improve her power by attracting target boys and love stealing.

424791.overview: Deka Voice is an Adventure game, developed by Acquire and published by SCEI, which was released in Japan in 2003.

424793.overview: This multimedia application lets you see what it's like to be a DJ. You download a song from your favorite CD onto the PS2 hard disk and mix it to create your own cool sound. The game lets you choose from multiple effects as you make your sound.

424794.overview: Jiorama Sensen Ijou Nashi: Stalingrad e no Michi is a strategy/sim game with roleplaying overtones, often also referred to as Diorama or Georama. In this simulation RPG, you send tanks out to the battle field to successfully accomplish timed missions. The game's theme is based on World War II's European front. Once you've selected a mission, the game begins on an overhead map as you select destinations for your tanks. The tanks then move automatically, picking up items along the way. You enter battle once your units come in contact with enemy forces.

424796.overview:
Aspacia is the princess of Evuu. One day, the fifteen year old lost her magic. When she went to her father for answers, he told her it was because of her awakening human blood. To regain her powers, the princess has to travel to the human world and grant wishes, the more she does the faster she could go back to her pampered life in the palace.

After two months of traveling, she reached a desert kingdom filled with charming men and their desires. How you respond to them will be up to you, and who's wishes you grant first will affect your chances with the men.

424801.overview: Derby Uma o Tsukurou! 5 is a Sports game, developed by Land Ho! and published by Sega, which was released in Japan in 2006.

424803.overview:
Doko Demo Issyo: Toro and More Parties (どこでもいっしょトロといっぱい) is a Video Game developed by BeXide and published by Sony Computer Entertainment, Inc. It was released on September 2nd, 2004 for the PlayStation 2, and would mark the debut of Kuro. The game is compatible with the PS2's EyeToy accessory. 

Toro has come to live in a vacant lot with feral cats, and eventually the vacant lot will be filled with the words by the player.

424804.overview: Dear my friend - Love like powdery snow: This love simulation has been ported to the PS2 from the PC, complete with new illustrations. The story asks the question, can friendship be had between a man and a woman? Taking place in a high school over a one month period, you, playing as a freshman, will use your lunch break and home room period to get to know a number of different girls. The game begins when a young girl comes to live with you and your parents.

424805.overview: On a rainy night, a woman brought a baby to a church in the country and left her to the priest. The priest named her Amelia and raised her as his own. Seventeen years later, Amelia's idyllic life in the same church will come to an end when group of gangsters suddenly appear at its door, and her fate will be unraveled when she receives a mysterious pendant after fleeing the gang.

424807.overview: Dream Audition 3 is an Action game, published by Pacific Century Cyber Works, which was released in Japan in 2001.

424810.overview: W: Wish is an Adventure game, developed by Oaks Soft and published by Princess Soft, which was released in Japan in 2004.

424811.overview: Doko e Iku No, Ano Hi for PlayStation 2 was originally a PC title and is a Japanese-style love simulation. Doko e Iku No, Ano Hi (the title could translate to "Where Are You Going, That Day") takes place in the town of Morizonochou and places players in the role of Kyousuke Kunimi. Kunimi has a strange experience one day that gets him involved with five girls from Kirishiki Gakuen, his school. Players work their way through the game by selecting choices in coversation which change the outcome of the story. The PlayStation 2 version adds new art and new event scenes. Don't worry -- Princess Soft has gone about recording new voice over sequences for the new events, keeping the game full voice as it was on the PC.

424813.overview: Doko Demo Issyo - Toro to Nagareboshi: One clear night, Toro and a human friend named Pokebi are peering out a window in the hopes of spotting a shooting star. One whizzes by with the quickness and Toro makes his wish. Thrice. Although the star appeared to be streaking across the sky, Toro's eyes grow as big as saucers when he realizes that the star has miraculously changed course and is now headed directly for him and Pocket Biscuit (Pokebi). A bright light, a roaring sound and the sight of Toro leaping to safety ensues.

424814.overview: Dream Audition Super Hit Disc 2 is an Action game, published by Pacific Century Cyber Works, which was released in Japan in 2001.

424830.overview: In Duel Savior Destiny the player's adventure begins when he opens up a mysterious red book and is instantly transported to another world. There, in addition to hooking up with a number of girls in school girl outfits, you'll also take part in 2D, side-view battles which feature a simple control scheme. Alchemist is adding extra voice and illustrations on top of what was already featured in the PC version.

424842.overview:
Demos: ATV Offroad Fury, Zone of the Enders, Red Faction, Star Wars: Starfighter, Army Men: Green Rogue, Army Men: Air Attack 2, WinBack: Covert Operations
Videos: NHL FaceOff 2001, NBA ShootOut 2001, Gauntlet Dark Legacy, Soul Reaver 2, The Bouncer, Dark Cloud, Onimusha: Warlords

438274.overview:
"Toukon Spirit" Antonio Inoki produces a wrestling-style puzzle game!

Easy rules and hot competition! A puzzle game with easy rules and hot battles!
The controls and rules are simple, as everyone can easily get used to the falling object puzzle! The game also features powerful cut-in animations, flashy sound effects, and other exciting effects!

Full cooperation from the Inoki Office, which is great for pro-wrestling fans!
Antonio Inoki and other popular wrestlers of New Japan Pro Wrestling appear with their real names! Hidekazu Tanaka (Kero-chan), an active ring announcer, does the live announcements! The background music is the passionate "Inokibombaye"!

Full of treasured audio and video data for Inoki fans!
In the "Toukon Memorial Hall" mode, you can listen to Inoki's many "Inoki's words" in live voice, as well as watch videos of his famous fights! In addition, there are also secret videos that can only be seen in this game!

438352.overview:
A version for the PlayStation 2 under the title Da Capo II: Plus Situation was released on May 29, 2008 in limited and regular editions. The PS2 version promoted three of the former supporting charactersMaya Sawai, Akane Hanasaki, and Mayuki Kosaka to become obtainable heroines, along with the introduction of three original heroines Erika Murasaki, Mahiru Takanashi, and Aishia.

The Deluxe Pack was released in a Box set containing the 2-DVD game, an special arc "Harukaze P.S ~Plus Situation~", an anime DVD with interviews and a piano soundtrack.

Circus issued a recall of early batches because they were said to have a defect on either one or both the bonus discs; however, past Dec. 2008, returns to manufacturer are no longer accepted.

439117.overview: Diet Channel (ダイエットチャンネル) is a Japanese-exclusive music and exercise fitness video game developed and published by Konami for the PlayStation 2 console.Released on March 4, 2004, the title serves as a direct spin-off of the popular Dance Dance Revolution (DDR) series and is the chronological successor to Aerobics Revolution.

441376.overview: Dokapon DX is a board game with RPG elements. This is the sequel of Dokapon Legend IV from 1993. The game features both battle mode and story mode. In the story mode your mission is to defend the Dokapon kingdom and battle against the enemies. The battle mode supports up to 4 players simultaneously.

446690.overview: DDRMAX: Dance Dance Revolution 6th Mix is an Action game, published by Konami, which was released in Japan in 2001.

448210.overview: All the power of DBZ is yours. A Hall of Fame cast of the greatest DBZ, DBGT and DBZ movie characters meet for first time for some of the fastest paced, highest intensity battles ever seen. New abilities include, for the first time on PlayStation 2, the ability to fly at will in a DBZ fighting game. Pummel your foes on the ground and in the air. In North America, an exclusive re-release package of the game (for the PlayStation "Greatest Hits" line) was released. It contained extras not included in the original black label release. This special version includes an unlockable bonus feature that lets you listen to the original Japanese voice over cast, as well an additional unlockable costume for Goku, Piccolo, and Trunks. It also uses the original Japanese cover art for the case.

458609.overview: The game starts in 1936 with a cutscene that shows the death of Johnny Trapani, the father of the main character Aldo Trapani (The sequel confirmed that this is the canon name) and the blowing up of his bakery by the Barzini crime family, one of the Corleones' rivals in New York. In the aftermath, Don Vito Corleone (Marlon Brando/Bill Melien) comforts the child, telling him that when he is old enough and the time is right he will have his revenge. The story then fastforwards with the 1945 wedding scene in the opening of the film, wherein Aldo's mother asks Don Corleone to look after him, who has been hanging with the wrong crowd. Luca Brasi (Terry McGovern/Gary Chalk) is sent to recruit Aldo and teach him the ways of the Mafia. From this point forward, Aldo is taken under the Corleone Family's wing and works his way up in the organization.

464928.overview:
Prototype of "Duke Nukem: D-Day", also known under the titles "Man of Valor" and "American Bad Ass", the cancelled third game in the n-Space series of third-person Duke Nukem games, following "Duke Nukem: Time to Kill" and "Duke Nukem: Land of the Babes".

The game was remarkably far along in development at this stage, with 12 levels being available inside the menu select, and a plethora of weapons to try out. A more unserious person might even claim that the game was "90% complete".

Interestingly, development for the game continued up until its cancellation in 2003. One can only wonder how much more complete the product was at that stage -- much like a certain other prototype out there.

474104.overview: Devil Summoner: Kuzunoha Raidou tai Abaddon-ou Plus is an exclusive, limited-edition Japanese compilation bundle released for the Sony PlayStation 2 on October 23, 2008. It is highly sought after by collectors within the Shin Megami Tensei franchise because it serves as the only way to obtain a specific, upgraded version of a classic title.

479914.overview: Developed by Relentless Software and published by Sony, it was created in direct partnership with Radio FG, France’s premier electronic and house music radio station. Rather than being a game with high scores, it functions as an open-ended audio sandbox designed to teach users the basics of electronic music mixing. The standalone feature of this specific edition is its curated French Touch and House tracklist, sporting Radio FG branding on the cover. It features roughly 70 tracks from prominent electronic artists of the era, including: Martin Solveig, Bob Sinclar, Antoine Clamaran, Shapeshifters, Dimitri from Paris, ...

479916.overview: While the base game (DJ: Decks & FX - House Edition) was distributed across Europe, it was manufactured and distributed solely for the Spanish market. The game specifically features audio material, licensing, and branding themed around The Privilege-X Maxiclubbing, a prominent nightclub brand and event scene in Spain. Unlike other editions—such as the French FG DJ Radio Edition—this version swaps out standard commercial tracks to focus entirely on anthems and electronic club sets tailored to Spain's Ibiza-style party subculture.
